name: Doorman

notes: An ancient title not granted in many years.
A Doorman is bound to a specific Arch.
The role includes opening and closing access to an Arch, maintaining its connection, and protecting it.
Gerk is being offered this position.
A Doorman serves as the guardian of an individual Arch.
A Doorman can open and close access to their assigned realm.
Modern Doormen are expected to actively improve and protect their Arch instead of merely hiding its keystone.

openQuestions: Which Arch will Gerk ultimately become Doorman of?
